star.title: Conversion complete. Thank you!
star.message: Your first conversion is complete! If this tool helped, please consider starring the project on GitHub.
star.subDefault: Your 3D Gaussian splat has been processed and saved locally.
star.body:
Splat Convert Desktop is a free, open-source local desktop GUI. Core 3D Gaussian compression, conversion, and filtering are powered by PlayCanvas's open-source @playcanvas/splat-transform engine.

Heartfelt thanks to the PlayCanvas authors and contributors! If this tool helped you, please consider starring both this app and the upstream engine (shown once).

models.sam21TinyTooltip: [Bundled Default · Recommended] SAM 2.1 Hiera Tiny FP16 (~74 MB). Fully offline single-file bundle offering the best balance of speed, VRAM use, occlusion handling, and small-object accuracy.
models.mobileSamTooltip: [Fast & Lightweight · ~43 MB] Significantly reduces VRAM usage and speeds up iGPU/CPU (WASM) inference; great for low-spec PCs or clean objects, with slightly lower accuracy on complex edges/occlusions than SAM 2.1.
models.sam21SmallTooltip: [High Precision · ~88 MB] Deeper backbone than Tiny for finer segmentation on thin handles, foliage, and overlapping objects; slightly higher per-view inference time and VRAM use.
models.lamaTooltip: [L2 Plane Inpainting Default · ~198 MB] Fast Fourier Convolution (non-diffusion) inpainting that seamlessly continues wood grain, tile seams, and fabric patterns in 1–2s and back-projects onto the fitted plane.

mode.title: Mode: Batch vs Merge
mode.summary: Convert multiple files individually or merge them into one scene.
mode.up: Batch Convert: outputs one converted file per input automatically.
mode.down: Merge All: combines multiple scans into a single scene file.
mode.recommend: Keep Batch Convert for everyday multi-file conversion.

format.title: Export Format
format.summary: Determines file size and viewer/editor compatibility.
format.up: SOG / HTML give 10–20x compression; SPZ is lightweight & portable.
format.down: Standard PLY is largest but best for further 3D editing.
format.recommend: Choose SOG for web, HTML for instant sharing, PLY for editing.

preset.title: Quick Presets
preset.summary: Automatically tunes point ratio, SH bands, iterations, and WebP effort.
preset.up: Fast: quickest preview; High Quality: 100% points & full SH.
preset.down: Compact: smallest mobile size; Balanced: best overall trade-off.
preset.recommend: Start with Balanced for web, or Fast for quick tests.

keep.title: Keep Points % (Decimation)
keep.summary: Merges redundant Gaussians so large scans run smoothly on web/mobile.
keep.up: 100% keeps every point with original quality and largest size.
keep.down: 45%–75% dramatically shrinks file size and VRAM use.
keep.recommend: For scenes over 2M splats, try 50%–75% with adaptive decimation.

adaptive.title: Adaptive Decimation
adaptive.summary: Allocates point removal by local visual error instead of uniformly.
adaptive.up: Preserves fine details and skies much better on mixed-scale scenes.
adaptive.down: Uniform mode is slightly faster with lower peak RAM.

iterations.title: SH Compression Iterations
iterations.summary: Controls clustering precision for view-dependent specular highlights.
iterations.up: Higher (15–25) improves reflection fidelity but takes longer.
iterations.down: Lower (3–8) encodes much faster for previews.

effort.title: WebP Effort (0–9)
effort.summary: Lossless WebP compression effort for packed SOG textures.
effort.up: Higher (up to 9) yields smaller files with zero quality loss, slower CPU.
effort.down: 0 packs very fast with slightly larger output.
effort.recommend: 0 for fast, Default for balanced, 8–9 for publishing.

workers.title: Encoding Workers
workers.summary: Number of parallel CPU threads for texture packing.
workers.up: More workers finish faster but use more CPU and RAM.
workers.down: Fewer workers (or 0 serial) keep RAM usage lower.
workers.recommend: 4 is safe; 6–8 works great on 32GB+ systems.

voxel.title: Voxel Size (meters)
voxel.summary: Edge length of each collision voxel cell.
voxel.up: Larger (0.1–0.2m) is coarser, smaller, and faster.
voxel.down: Smaller (0.03–0.05m) captures fine geometry with higher VRAM.

opacity.title: Voxel Opacity Threshold
opacity.summary: Minimum opacity required for a splat to count as solid.
opacity.up: Higher filters out wispy fog to avoid invisible walls.

device.title: Compute Device & Vulkan
device.summary: SOG compression, floater removal, and voxelization run 5–10x faster on GPU.
device.up: Vulkan works around Windows D3D12 driver issues cleanly.
device.down: CPU Only avoids VRAM limits but runs 5–10x slower.
device.recommend: Use Auto GPU first; switch to Vulkan if GPU errors occur.

floaters.title: Remove Floaters (--filter-floaters)
floaters.summary: Uses GPU voxelization to strip floating noise artifacts from scans.
floaters.up: Produces cleaner visuals and smaller files.
floaters.recommend: Recommended for phone and drone captures.

cluster.title: Keep Main Cluster
cluster.summary: Keeps only the connected main cluster around the seed point.
cluster.recommend: Useful for isolated rooms or objects.

nan.title: Remove Invalid Points (NaN/Inf)
nan.summary: Strips corrupted coordinates or zero-norm rotations.
nan.up: Prevents black artifacts and renderer crashes with zero quality loss.

sh.title: Limit SH Bands
sh.summary: Caps spherical harmonic bands, which often take >50% of file size.
sh.down: Band 0 or 1 cuts file size in half with minimal visual change.
sh.recommend: Use 1 for web, 0 for ultra-compact mobile.

translate.title: Translate (X, Y, Z)
translate.summary: Shifts the entire scene along X, Y, and Z axes.
translate.up: Helpful for recentering off-origin scans to (0,0,0).
translate.recommend: Useful when aligning multiple merged scans.

rotate.title: Rotate (Degrees)
rotate.summary: Rotates the scene around X, Y, and Z axes.
rotate.up: Fixes upside-down or tilted phone captures.
rotate.recommend: Try Auto Align or 3-Point Plane Align directly in 3D Edit.

scale.title: Uniform Scale
scale.summary: Resizes the entire scene by a uniform multiplier.
scale.recommend: Use to match target game engine units.

box.title: Bounding Box Filter
box.summary: Keeps only splats inside the min/max XYZ box.
box.down: Tighter box crops away messy backgrounds.
box.recommend: Great for rooms and rectangular areas.

sphere.title: Sphere Filter
sphere.summary: Keeps only splats within a radius around a center point.
sphere.down: Smaller radius trims far edges cleanly.

estOutput.title: Estimated Output Size
estOutput.summary: Estimated from input splat count, target format, keep %, and SH bands.
estOutput.up: Preview size savings immediately as you adjust sliders.
estOutput.down: Actual size varies slightly with scene complexity.
estOutput.recommend: Switch presets or drag sliders to compare sizes.

engine.title: Decoupled Engine Updater
engine.summary: Bundles v3.12.0 offline and pulls updates via China & global mirrors.
engine.up: Auto-fallback across npmmirror, Tencent, Huawei, and npmjs with SHA-512 check.
engine.down: One-click rollback to bundled version anytime.
engine.recommend: Click to test mirror latency or pull the latest engine.

preview3d.title: 3D Gaussian Edit (+Y up · Non-destructive)
preview3d.summary: Opens the full 3D Gaussian Editor: Splat/Centers/Rings display, 6-face volumes & clipping planes, smart/semantic selection, color grading, and auto-alignment.
preview3d.up: Overwrite Save replaces only the file in the active workflow without touching the original file on disk.
preview3d.down: You can also use Save As inside the editor to export merged, per-object, or per-group.
preview3d.recommend: Select any input file and click to start non-destructive editing.

advTargetCap.title: Target Size Cap (MB)
advTargetCap.summary: Sets a strict file-size ceiling for SOG / HTML output (0 = unlimited) and retries with lower keep % if exceeded.
advTargetCap.up: Strictly enforces web publishing bundle limits.
advTargetCap.down: Set to 0 to encode once with current parameters (fastest).
advTargetCap.recommend: Use 15–30 MB for mobile sharing, or 0 for desktop.

advMinKeep.title: Auto-Target Min Keep Points %
advMinKeep.summary: Lowest point retention % allowed during automatic target-size retries.
advMinKeep.up: Higher prevents excessive blurring from over-decimation.
advMinKeep.down: Lower gives the auto-target loop more room to shrink size.
advMinKeep.recommend: Default 20% balances size hit rate and clarity.

advSogVer.title: SOG Format Version (v3 / v2)
advSogVer.summary: Selects the SuperSplat SOG container protocol version.
advSogVer.up: v3 uses improved quaternion and opacity quantization for better quality and smaller size.
advSogVer.down: v2 is only for compatibility with very old web viewers.
advSogVer.recommend: Keep default v3 unless legacy compatibility is required.

advShErr.title: SH Color Error Target
advShErr.summary: Sets the maximum acceptable color error threshold for SH clustering (leave blank for engine default).
advShErr.up: Lower values give more accurate reflections but encode slower and larger.

advSpzVer.title: SPZ Compression Version (v4 / v3)
advSpzVer.summary: Selects the Niantic/Adobe SPZ format protocol version.
advSpzVer.up: v4 improves compression efficiency and supports newer decoders.
advSpzVer.down: v3 supports legacy SPZ ecosystem plugins.

advPlyLogit.title: PLY Legacy Logit Opacity
advPlyLogit.summary: Stores opacity in classic 3DGS logit space when exporting standard PLY.
advPlyLogit.up: Ensures compatibility with legacy 3DGS, SuperSplat, and Blender plugins.
advPlyLogit.down: Uses engine default linear opacity output.
advPlyLogit.recommend: Enable when round-tripping to older external editors.

advHtmlUnbundled.title: Unbundled HTML Output
advHtmlUnbundled.summary: Outputs web player scripts and Gaussian data as separate files instead of a single self-contained HTML.
advHtmlUnbundled.up: Ideal for static web hosting and browser caching.
advHtmlUnbundled.down: Single-file HTML is easier to share directly for offline viewing.
advHtmlUnbundled.recommend: Keep off for direct sharing; enable for web server deployment.

advVoxelFlags.title: Advanced Voxel Collision Fill Options
advVoxelFlags.summary: Controls interior sealing, outdoor floor fill, navigable carving, and collision mesh generation.
advVoxelFlags.up: Enabling fills scan holes so game characters don't clip through walls or floors.
advVoxelFlags.down: Disabled keeps raw occupied scan voxels.
advVoxelFlags.recommend: Enable per scene type only when exporting Voxel collision bundles.

advTipDelay.title: Global Tooltip Hover Delay (ms)
advTipDelay.summary: Global hover delay constant: tooltips appear only after resting the cursor for this duration.
advTipDelay.up: Higher (800–1200ms) stays quieter for experienced users.
advTipDelay.recommend: Default 500ms balances responsiveness and distraction-free use across all windows.

advHistoryLimit.title: 3D Editor Max History Steps
advHistoryLimit.summary: Sets the maximum incremental Undo/Redo stack depth in the 3D Editor.
advHistoryLimit.up: Higher (80–200) keeps longer edit trails with slightly more RAM.
advHistoryLimit.recommend: Default 50 steps is plenty for most cleanup tasks.

advVeteranTips.title: Per-Region Veteran Tooltip Toggles
advVeteranTips.summary: Independently toggle hover tooltips per UI region so experienced users can mute familiar areas.
advVeteranTips.up: Checked shows detailed hover hints in that region.
advVeteranTips.down: Unchecked mutes tooltips in that region (saved automatically).
advVeteranTips.recommend: Keep only unfamiliar regions enabled and restore anytime here.

inspectDeep.title: Deep Engine Inspection (--stats)
inspectDeep.summary: Scans all Gaussians via the underlying engine to report coordinate bounds, scales, opacity, and anomaly distributions.
inspectDeep.up: Pinpoints oversized floaters or corrupted numerical values.
inspectDeep.down: Scanning huge files (>2M splats) takes a few seconds.
inspectDeep.recommend: Use when diagnosing blurry renders or stray artifacts.

jobsResume.title: Resume / Retry Job Manifests
jobsResume.summary: Reads saved job manifests from data/jobs/ and reloads source files into the workflow.
jobsResume.up: Quickly recover interrupted batch jobs without losing file lists.
jobsResume.down: Does not modify historical files on disk.
jobsResume.recommend: Use after an interrupted large batch export.

guides.orbit: [Browse Mode] Left-drag orbit, Right/Middle-drag pan, Wheel zoom; double-click any splat to set pivot & show 3D gizmo (W/E/R); right-click for volumes & quick actions.
guides.rect: [Rect Select] Left-drag to draw a rectangle (default Replace · Ctrl temp Add · Alt temp Subtract · Ctrl+Alt Intersect); Right-drag orbits, Middle-drag pans.
guides.lasso: [Lasso Select] Left-drag to sketch a closed region (default Replace · Ctrl temp Add · Alt temp Subtract); toggle Visible Only / Whole Gaussian below.
guides.ellipse: [Ellipse Select] Left-drag to draw an ellipse (default Replace · Ctrl temp Add · Alt temp Subtract); Right-drag orbits anytime.
guides.poly: [Polygon Select] Click vertices, double-click / Enter / click start point to close; Esc to cancel.
guides.brush: [Brush Select] Left-drag to paint selection (default Replace · Ctrl temp Add · Alt temp Subtract); use [ / ] or slider to adjust radius (up to 360px).
guides.eyedropper: [Eyedropper Select] Left-click model to sample target color and select matching Gaussians (default Replace · Ctrl temp Add · Alt temp Subtract); press 1 to toggle Browse.
guides.opacitySel: [Opacity Select] Drag the opacity range sliders below to preview matches, then click Replace / Add / Subtract / Intersect.
guides.sizeSel: [Size Select] Filter oversized spikes or tiny noise by max axis, mean scale, or elongation ratio, then click a boolean action below.
guides.semanticSel: [Semantic Box] Hold Shift + Left-drag to box an object (plain Left-drag orbits freely; default Replace · Ctrl temp Add · Alt temp Subtract); switch Auto/2D/3D below; press M to exit.
guides.planeInpaint: [Plane Inpaint] Hold Shift + Left-drag to box a hole (plain Left-drag orbits, or click Reuse Last Hole); supports L0 Solid Color, L1 Fast Geometry & L2 Smart Inpaint; press J to exit.
guides.floaterSel: [Floater Select] Detects isolated airborne floaters via 3D voxel neighbor density; adjust voxel size & max neighbors below, then apply.
guides.volume: [Volume Handles] Drag colored face handles to push/pull that face; hold Shift for symmetric scaling; or use W/E/R gizmo / Transform panel. Selections stay inside active volumes.
guides.plane: [Infinite Clip Plane] Active only on the camera-facing side of the plane; automatically flips as you orbit behind it. Intersects with active volumes.
guides.autoAlign: [Auto Align (+Y up)] Detects floor to Y=0, aligns walls to X/Z axes, and centers subject above origin as a single undoable step (Ctrl+Z).
guides.verticalAlign: [Vertical Align (+Y up)] Click bottom then top of a true vertical edge to smoothly align to +Y; use Flip / Undo / Repick below.
guides.groundAlign: [Plane Align (+Y up)] Click 3 non-collinear points on a flat surface to smoothly level it to Y=0; use Flip / Undo / Repick below.
guides.scaleCalib: [Scale Calibration] Click 2 points of known distance on the surface and enter the real length (m/cm/mm) to non-destructively calibrate measurements.
guides.smartMeasure: [Smart Measuring Pen] Left-click solid surface to measure distance/polyline (>=3 pts: double-click start vertex or click Close below for Area/Volume); drag vertices to refine, Backspace undoes last point, press T to exit.

contextBar.onlyVisibleTip: Uses real-time GPU ID/depth picking to select only unoccluded foreground surface Gaussians.
contextBar.wholeGaussianTip: Selects any Gaussian whose ellipsoid overlaps the selection, matching the Rings mode contour exactly.
contextBar.semModeAutoTip: Automatically chooses 2D (planar patch) or 3D (volumetric object, preferred) from 3D coplanarity and edge depth discontinuity.
contextBar.semMode2dTip: Locks 2D planar segmentation (surface or adjustable/infinite depth); re-runs immediately if a previous box exists.
contextBar.semMode3dTip: Locks 3D multi-view object segmentation (ring + upper hemisphere + occlusion filter); re-runs immediately if a previous box exists.

credits.title: Open-Source Credits & Licenses
credits.resplat: Referenced for Rings display mode & contours, full color grading (8-band HSL / 3D LUT / SH bake), smart selection tools, local SAM 2 semantic segmentation, bit-exact PNG export, and dark pro UI layout.
credits.supersplat: Upstream 3D Gaussian editor paradigm and spherical harmonics (SH Band 1–3) rotation matrix algorithm (based on Andrew Willmott sh-lib).
credits.spirula: Referenced for 6-face push/pull volume handles (Shift symmetric scaling), +Y up auto floor/wall alignment concepts, and selection workflow design (clean-room implementation).
credits.splatTransform: Core 3D Gaussian codec, SOG/SPZ/PLY/HTML conversion, and decimation engine.
credits.gse: Reference for Opacity Select and Size Select tool interactions.

saveOverwrite.title: Overwrite Save (Non-destructive)
saveOverwrite.tip: Replaces only the active workflow file without modifying the original source on disk; final re-encoding runs at export.

saveAs.title: Save As Export
saveAs.tip: Exports edited results directly to a chosen folder (merged, per-object, or per-group) using main window encoder settings.

menuBounds.title: Model Bounding Corners
menuBounds.tip: Displays thin corner brackets at the 8 corners of the active model's 3D bounding box.

menuGrid.title: Infinite Ground Grid
menuGrid.tip: Renders an anti-aliased infinite reference grid on the Y=0 ground plane (+Y-up, with red X / blue Z origin axes).

colorPanel.title: Color Grading Panel
colorPanel.tip: Grades the active object (or selection when points are selected) with histogram, 8-band HSL, 3D LUT, and SH baking.

isolate.title: Isolate Selected
isolate.tip: Shows only the currently selected Gaussians and temporarily hides all others.

hide.title: Hide Selected
hide.tip: Temporarily hides selected Gaussians to expose occluded interior details.

showAll.title: Show All
showAll.tip: Clears all temporary hide/isolate states and restores all non-deleted Gaussians.

boundsTop.title: Model Bounding Corners
boundsTop.tip: Toggles L-shaped corner brackets around the 3D Gaussian bounding box.

gridTop.title: Infinite Ground Grid
gridTop.tip: Toggle the infinite Y=0 reference grid and origin X/Z axes.

exportImgTop.title: Export View Image
exportImgTop.tip: Renders and exports the current camera view as PNG at custom resolution (supports transparency & hiding helpers).

displayMode.title: Display Mode
displayMode.tip: Full-res per-splat control: Splat (true 3D Gaussians), Centers (fast diamond centers), and Rings (outer ellipsoid contours for spotting floaters).

camOrbit.title: Orbit Camera
camOrbit.tip: Orbits around focus point: Left-drag rotate, Right/Middle-drag pan, Wheel zoom; double-click any splat to set pivot & show gizmo.

camFly.title: Fly Camera
camFly.tip: First-person walk/fly view for large scenes: Left-drag look around, Wheel dolly, W/A/S/D move, Q/E move along +Y (Shift boost / Alt slow).

flySpeed.title: Fly Movement Speed
flySpeed.tip: Auto-calibrated to the loaded model scale; drag to tune speed or double-click value to reset (Shift 2.8× / Alt 0.3× while flying).

orbit.title: Browse & Object Pick
orbit.tip: Left-drag orbit, Right-drag pan; double-click a splat to set pivot and show the 3D gizmo.

rect.title: Box Select
rect.tip: Drag a rectangle to select Gaussians (default Replace · Ctrl temp Add / Alt temp Subtract).

lasso.title: Lasso Select
lasso.tip: Draw a freehand closed selection loop.

ellipse.title: Ellipse Select
ellipse.tip: Drag to draw an elliptical selection.

poly.title: Polygon Select
poly.tip: Click vertices to draw a polygon; double-click or press Enter to close.

brush.title: Brush Select
brush.tip: Hold and paint to select Gaussians; press [ / ] to adjust radius.

eyedropper.title: Eyedropper Select
eyedropper.tip: Click to sample color and select matching Gaussians by RGB/HSV tolerance.

opacitySel.title: Opacity Select
opacitySel.tip: Filter translucent fog or ghosting by opacity range.

sizeSel.title: Size Select
sizeSel.tip: Filter oversized or needle-like outlier Gaussians by axis scale or aspect ratio.

semanticSel.title: Semantic Select
semanticSel.tip: Hold Shift + Left-drag to box an object for Auto 2D/3D semantic segmentation (Ctrl temp Add / Alt temp Subtract; plain Left-drag orbits; press M to cancel).

floaterSel.title: Floater Select
floaterSel.tip: Detects isolated airborne floaters using 3D voxel neighborhood density.

autoAlign.title: Auto Align (+Y up)
autoAlign.tip: Snaps ground to Y=0, aligns walls to X/Z, and centers subject above origin (single-step undo).

verticalAlign.title: Vertical Align
verticalAlign.tip: Click bottom then top of a vertical edge to smoothly align to +Y; supports 180° flip and undo.

groundAlign.title: Plane Align
groundAlign.tip: Click 3 points on a flat surface to smoothly level it to Y=0; supports 180° flip and undo.

scaleCalib.title: Scale Calibration
scaleCalib.tip: Click 2 points of known distance and enter real length (m/cm/mm) to non-destructively calibrate global measurement scale.

smartMeasure.title: Smart Ruler
smartMeasure.tip: 2 pts: distance/ΔH/slope · 3+ pts: polyline · closed: area/volume (smart edge snap + 4 volume inspection views).

flyoutFilter.title: Smart Selection Menu
flyoutFilter.tip: Contains Eyedropper (Y), Opacity (O), Size (K), Semantic (M), and Floater (F) filters.

flyoutAlign.title: Pose Alignment Menu
flyoutAlign.tip: Contains Auto Align (A), Vertical Align (U), and Plane Align (L).

flyoutMeasure.title: Spatial Measurement Menu
flyoutMeasure.tip: Contains Scale Calibration (Shift+T) and Smart Ruler (T).

undo.title: Undo
undo.tip: Non-destructive incremental undo of the last action.

gizmoTranslate.title: Translate Gizmo
gizmoTranslate.tip: Precisely move selected objects or volumes along X/Y/Z axes.

gizmoRotate.title: Rotate Gizmo
gizmoRotate.tip: Rotate selected objects or volumes around the pivot.

gizmoScale.title: Scale Gizmo
gizmoScale.tip: Scale selected objects or volumes per-axis or uniformly.

flyoutSmart.title: Smart Tools
flyoutSmart.tip: Expand smart repair & generation tools (Plane Inpaint L0 Solid / L1 / L2).

planeInpaint.title: Plane Inpaint
planeInpaint.tip: Hold Shift + Left-drag to box a surface hole (plain Left-drag orbits); supports L0 Solid Color / L1 / L2 inpainting.

localSpace.title: Use Local Space
localSpace.tip: Toggles 3D gizmo orientation between Local Space and World Space (+Y up).

boundsCenter.title: Use Bounds Center
boundsCenter.tip: Snaps gizmo to the geometric center of the selected object's bounding box; auto-disables when setting a custom pivot or editing origin.

pivotEdit.title: Edit Pivot Origin
pivotEdit.tip: Moves only the gizmo pivot without moving the model; turn off to rotate/scale/move around the new pivot.

scaleLock.title: Uniform Scale Lock
scaleLock.tip: When locked, editing any X/Y/Z scale value scales all three axes proportionally.

resetPos.title: Reset Position
resetPos.tip: Resets models to (0, 0, 0) and volumes to their initial creation position (undoable).

resetRot.title: Reset Rotation
resetRot.tip: Resets models to (0, 0, 0) and volumes to their initial orientation (undoable).

resetScale.title: Reset Scale
resetScale.tip: Resets models to (1, 1, 1) and volumes to their initial size (undoable).

clearObjSel.title: Clear Object Selection
clearObjSel.tip: Deselects current objects so the bounding corners wrap all active splats in the scene.

expandObjects.title: Expand/Collapse Objects
expandObjects.tip: Expands the full scene object list without scrolling.

expandVolumes.title: Expand/Collapse Volumes
expandVolumes.tip: Expands all volumes and nested groups.

historyToggle.title: Expand/Collapse History
historyToggle.tip: Shows the latest 3 steps when collapsed; click any step to jump non-destructively.

groupBtn.title: Group
groupBtn.tip: Groups multi-selected objects or volumes (Ctrl+G); volume groups support nesting and top-to-bottom booleans.

ungroupBtn.title: Ungroup
ungroupBtn.tip: Ungroups the selected object group or volume group.

addVolBtn.title: Add Volume / Clip Plane
addVolBtn.tip: Creates a Bounding Box, Ellipsoid, Cylinder, or Infinite Clip Plane.

transformCard.title: Precise Transform (+Y up)
transformCard.tip: Numerically edit position, rotation, and scale for selected objects, volumes, or groups.

histogram.title: RGB & Luminance Histogram
histogram.tip: Live color and exposure distribution for the active scope; top-left blue dot warns underexposure, top-right red warns clipping.

compareHold.title: Hold to Compare Original
compareHold.tip: Hold button or backslash key \ to preview the ungraded original.

compareSplit.title: Split Comparison
compareSplit.tip: Enables a draggable pixel-accurate split screen (Original left / Graded right).

colorApply.title: Apply & Bake to SH
colorApply.tip: Bakes current live color grading into the selection or object's SH coefficients as a single undo step.

imgTransparent.title: Transparent PNG
imgTransparent.tip: Exports PNG with lossless straight Alpha transparency for compositing.

imgHideHelpers.title: Auto-Hide Helpers
imgHideHelpers.tip: Automatically hides grid, volume wireframes & handles, gizmos, and selection highlights during PNG export.

vizGrid.label: Mesh Fit
vizGrid.tip: Dims interior splats and highlights the 2.5D surface mesh and base plane to verify fit
